doc_screened_files.reason: Direct owner of `variances_of`/`crate_variances`, matching the query stack and the panic site in variance computation. If closure/coroutine types are being admitted into variance analysis incorrectly, this is the top-level place it would surface.
Builds `ty::Generics` for closures and coroutines and synthesizes late-bound parameters. A bad closure/coroutine generic shape here can feed the variance pass an unexpected closure/coroutine type.

Drives HIR item collection into `rustc_middle::ty`, which is the data that variance later consumes. Corrupted or incomplete collection of item signatures can propagate directly into variance computation.
Assigns the variance inference slots and records hardcoded variances. If closure/coroutine-related items are misclassified before constraints are built, this layer is part of the failing pipeline.

Resolves lifetimes, late-bound vars, and captured lifetimes for closures and opaque types. Incorrect binder classification can introduce the malformed closure/coroutine types that variance later rejects.
Constructs closure and coroutine types from body context and expected signatures. This is a strong upstream source for the closure/coroutine types that the variance pass is complaining about.
Infers closure capture kinds and precision, which affects the shape of closure/coroutine types seen by later analysis. A capture bug here can change the type that variance computes over.

Checks function and closure bodies against signatures and builds the body context that later feeds HIR analysis. Because the ICE occurs while analyzing `g`, signature/body checking is a plausible upstream trigger.

Part of the same variance pipeline, even though the panic happens earlier in constraint building. If the unexpected closure/coroutine type is surviving into final variance handling, this solver is the next most relevant site.

Collects and augments item predicates used by later type and variance analysis. Mis-lowered predicates on items involving closures or coroutines can make the variance walk encounter unsupported forms.
